acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI website optimization for GEO varies significantly based on factors such as the size of your business, the number of locations, the competitiveness of your target markets, and the scope of services required. Packages often include initial audits, ongoing AI-powered optimizations, reporting, and strategic consultations. Prices can range from several hundred to several thousand dollars per month. A detailed quote is usually provided after an assessment of your specific needs and current digital presence.
